name: Ring of Blades
body:
School conjuration (creation) [metal]; Level bard 3, bloodrager 3, lathspell 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (A metal slashing weapon)

EFFECT

Range personal
Effect you
Duration 1 min./level (D)

You create a ring of spinning blades within an area of 5 feet around you. This ring of blades stays with you, and at the end of your turn, any creature within the area takes 1d6 non-magical slashing damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10). Such creatures can make a Reflex save to halve this damage.

Additionally, when casting the spell, if you use a weapon with the corresponding damage type, the blades can be considered silver or cold iron for damage reduction purposes. However, if the damage is silver, the slashing damage is reduced by 1.
